proposedTransport.checkoutPayload: Unmodified pinned ACP CheckoutSession in merchant-signed JWT, requiring an agreed AP2 Checkout Object extension/profile.
proposedTransport.mandates: Authenticated bridge sidecar scoped to checkout-session/revision/digest; no undeclared ACP top-level fields.
proposedTransport.credentials: Vault/trusted-UI/merchant payment boundary; never graph/checkpoint/log context.
proposedTransport.receipts: Authenticated signed-evidence store; graph sees opaque references and safe normalized state.
